title: Domain Expansion vs Simple Domain
script: This is Domain Expansion. This is Simple Domain. So what's the difference? Most fans think Simple Domain is just a weak Domain Expansion. It's not. Domain Expansion manifests your innate cursed technique into a barrier guaranteeing a sure-hit attack. But Simple Domain is an anti-domain barrier technique that neutralizes the sure-hit effect of an enemy's domain. Domain Expansion forces a guaranteed hit, while Simple Domain cancels it out. Follow for more.
